payload.body: DONE + on PR #8 (merged 4a9430a). GatewayHub::close_session live-closes WS connections (1008) + returns the count; AppStateInner.gateway (Weak, attach_gateway at boot); /auth/logout best-effort closes the token socket; admin sessions/revoke returns the real disconnected count. inspect tier now resolves FRICK_ADMIN_TOKEN: production REQUIRES the admin token, non-production accepts admin token OR any session (TODO(FR-246) closed). Live WS round-trip + auth tests.
